verdict.rationale: Convex has its own programmatic surfaces that cover many operations a user would otherwise do in the dashboard. The official CLI handles pushing functions and schema, running queries, mutations and actions, import/export, logs and health insights. An official MCP server lets agents interact with deployments, and public functions are exposed at HTTP endpoints. However, no evidence documents an API or CLI that matches every dashboard/UI capability, and no OpenAPI spec was found; by default the MCP server cannot access production deployments. Missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity, a management API covering deployment, team and settings operations, an OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration that agents can do everything without the dashboard.
